settlement_source: CF Benchmarks CME CF Solana-Dollar Real Time Index (SOLUSD_RTI), https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/SOLUSD_RTI ; terms https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/CRYPTO.pdf (generic template). Constituents: Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini, LMAX Digital, Bitstamp, Crypto.com. Order-book index, 1% depth parameter, 200 ms calc, 1/s dissemination at 0.01.
settlement_variable: Simple average of the 60 SOLUSD_RTI values in [T-60s,T); YES iff average > X.9999 strike (round_digits=4). Settled markets publish expiration_value to 4 dp (e.g. 100.2170). Revisions after expiration ignored.
timezone: US Eastern wall-clock (EDT/EST) in rules; UTC close_time in API. Contract template's '10:00 AM ET' is boilerplate.
tie_handling: Strikes X.9999 with strict >: effectively average >= X.0000 -> YES. Rounding of the average unknown (published to 4 dp).
rounding: RTI 0.01; expiration_value 4 dp (truncation vs round-half-up unknown); strikes at $0.25 increments on daily markets; min tick $0.001.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time == T; window fully tradable. settlement_timer 60 s; observed settlement ≈ T+2.5 min. Daily events list ~25 h ahead; hourly shorter.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early true. 'No data or incomplete data at expiration -> affected strikes resolve NO'; handling of <60 prints unspecified. Market Outcome Review 6.3(d)/(b). $25k accountability.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Template PDF says 10 AM ET / one-week; actual 5 PM ET or hourly
'at 5pm' vs minute 4:59:00–4:59:59; inclusion of T print unknown
Series says 'hourly' but lists daily 5 PM events too

toxicity_flags: Settlement window (T-60s..T) lies entirely inside live trading: anyone streaming the index can compute the running 60-s average; resting orders near the strike in the last minute are adversely selected
Settlement is a 60-s TWAP of an order-book index, not the spot/last-trade print; Coinbase/Binance tickers are proxies only
Kalshi does not publish the computed average for BTC (settlement_value null); rounding/boundary cases cannot be audited
Rounding/precision and window boundary (1-s vs 200-ms samples, inclusive/exclusive) unspecified
No data at expiration -> resolves NO (not void)
Kalshi Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3) and settlement delay (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion
CF Benchmarks is Kraken-owned (Payward); Kraken is a constituent; Expert Judgement permitted in extraordinary circumstances
Constituent set and methodology changed Jun-Sep 2026 (uncrossing, dynamic spacing, 200 ms effective time)
EDT/EST label changes with DST (Nov 1 2026); UTC close_time authoritative
Order-book index on thin SOL books: large resting orders can move the RTI without trades (manipulable over a 60-s window)
$0.25 strikes on ~$100 SOL (25 bps) decided by cents of average
Official tick data paywalled; retail cannot audit the 4-dp value except via replicas
